tests.name: Missing nfStatusNotificationUri
tests.constraint: The request body MUST be present and MUST conform to the SubscriptionData schema.

tests.name: Missing nfStatusNotificationUri
tests.constraint: The nfStatusNotificationUri property is required in the SubscriptionData request body.

tests.name: Invalid Content-Type Header
tests.constraint: The request body content type for the subscription creation MUST be application/json.

tests.name: Subscription with empty sharedDataIds
tests.constraint: If sharedDataIds is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 item.

tests.name: Invalid subscriptionId with hyphen
tests.constraint: The subscriptionId property, when present, MUST match the regular expression '^([0-9]{5,6}-(x3Lf57A:nid=[A-Fa-f0-9]{11}:)?)?[^-]+$'.

tests.name: Provide readOnly subscriptionId in request
tests.constraint: The subscriptionId property is readOnly and must not be provided by the client in the request.

tests.name: Invalid reqNotifEvents - empty array
tests.constraint: If reqNotifEvents is present, it MUST be an array and MUST contain at least 1 item, each item being one of the NotificationEventType enum values (e.g. NF_REGISTERED, NF_DEREGISTERED, NF_PROFILE_CHANGED, SHARED_DATA_CHANGED).

tests.name: Invalid reqSnssais Empty Array
tests.constraint: If reqSnssais is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 ExtSnssai item.

tests.name: Invalid reqPerPlmnSnssais - empty array
tests.constraint: If reqPerPlmnSnssais is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnSnssai item.

tests.name: Empty reqPlmnList
tests.constraint: If reqPlmnList is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnId item.

tests.name: Empty reqSnpnList (violates minItems)
tests.constraint: If reqSnpnList is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 PlmnIdNid item.

tests.name: ServingScope Empty Array
tests.constraint: If servingScope is present, it MUST be an array containing at least 1 string item.

tests.name: Include readOnly nrfSupportedFeatures in request
tests.constraint: The requesterFeatures property is writeOnly and is defined by the SupportedFeatures schema, meaning it can be provided by the client in the request (but will not be returned in read responses).

tests.name: Provide readOnly nrfSupportedFeatures in subscription request
tests.constraint: The nrfSupportedFeatures property is readOnly and must not be provided by the client in the request.

tests.name: Invalid extPreferredLocality Empty Object
tests.constraint: extPreferredLocality, when present, MUST be an object containing at least one property; each property value MUST be an array with at least one LocalityDescription item.

tests.name: Non-boolean completeProfileSubscription
tests.constraint: completeProfileSubscription is a boolean with default false and writeOnly; providing a non-boolean value violates the schema.

tests.name: Invalid subscrCond variant
tests.constraint: subscrCond, if present, MUST conform to one of the SubscrCond variants (oneOf): NfInstanceIdCond, NfInstanceIdListCond, NfTypeCond, ServiceNameCond, ServiceNameListCond, AmfCond, GuamiListCond, NetworkSliceCond, NfGroupCond, NfGroupListCond, NfSetCond, NfServiceSetCond, UpfCond, ScpDomainCond, NwdafCond, NefCond, or DccfCond.

tests.name: Missing nfInstanceId for NfInstanceIdCond
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NfInstanceIdCond, the nfInstanceId property is required.

tests.name: Empty NfInstanceIdList in SubscrCond
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NfInstanceIdListCond, the nfInstanceIdList property is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: SubscrCond NfTypeCond with forbidden nfGroupId
tests.constraint: If subscrCond.conditionType is NfTypeCond, subscrCond.nfType is required and subscrCond must not include nfGroupId or the pair conditionType + nfGroupIdList. This test includes a forbidden nfGroupId.

tests.name: Missing serviceName for ServiceNameCond
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is ServiceNameCond, the serviceName property is required.

tests.name: SubscrCond with empty serviceNameList
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is ServiceNameListCond, serviceNameList MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: SubscrCond AmfCond without amfSetId or amfRegionId
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is AmfCond, at least one of amfSetId or amfRegionId MUST be present.

tests.name: SubscrCond GuamiList Empty
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is GuamiListCond, guamiList is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: Invalid NetworkSliceCond with empty snssaiList and nsiList
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NetworkSliceCond, snssaiList is required and it MUST contain at least 1 item; if nsiList is present it MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: subscrCond nfGroupCond with forbidden nfType 'NRF'
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NfGroupCond, both nfType and nfGroupId are required and nfType is restricted to the enum [UDM, AUSF, UDR, PCF, CHF, HSS, BSF, UDSF].

tests.name: Invalid NfGroupListCond - wrong conditionType and empty nfGroupIdList
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NfGroupListCond, conditionType, nfType and nfGroupIdList are required and conditionType MUST have the value 'NF_GROUP_LIST_COND' and nfGroupIdList MUST contain at least 1 item.

tests.name: Missing nfSetId when subscrCond is NfSetCond
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NfSetCond, nfSetId is required.

tests.name: Missing nfServiceSetId when subscrCond is NfServiceSetCond
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NfServiceSetCond, nfServiceSetId is required.

tests.name: Invalid UpfCond conditionType value
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is UpfCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'UPF_COND'.

tests.name: Invalid NwdafCond conditionType
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NwdafCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'NWDAF_COND'.

tests.name: subscrCond with incorrect conditionType for NefCond
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is NefCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'NEF_COND'.

tests.name: Invalid DccfCond conditionType value
tests.constraint: If subscrCond is DccfCond, conditionType is required and MUST equal 'DCCF_COND'.

tests.name: NotifCondition Contains Both Monitored and Unmonitored Attributes
tests.constraint: notifCondition, if present, MUST NOT contain both monitoredAttributes and unmonitoredAttributes at the same time.

tests.name: Invalid nfStatusNotificationUri format
tests.constraint: The nfStatusNotificationUri must be a valid absolute URI usable as the callback endpoint (the callback uses '{$request.body#/nfStatusNotificationUri}' to POST NotificationData).
